lessons_learned: Piscina Worker Offloading: Bcrypt at cost 10-12 blocks the V8 event loop for 60-150ms per call. Moving password verification to Piscina worker threads preserves <5ms API p99 latency under concurrent login bursts.

Composite Rate Limiting: University campus environments route hundreds of students through shared NAT gateways. Keying rate limiters strictly by IP locks out legitimate students. Composite keying (${ip}:${email}) isolates rogue actors without impacting other students.

Zero-Memory Busboy Uploads: Unpiping streams upon binary signature mismatch causes @aws-sdk/lib-storage Upload.done() to reject with an AbortError. Catching and suppressing the abort rejection when streamValidationFailed is active prevents unhandled promise rejections while allowing Busboy's close handler to cleanly return HTTP 400 Bad Request.

Two-Stage Lexical Pre-Filter: Running fast inverted-index Winnowing candidate checks first eliminates >70% of redundant neural vector inference calls when student submissions are original (<5% lexical overlap).

Circuit Breaker Resilience: Wrapping external AI microservices (FastAPI / BGE-M3) with Opossum circuit breakers prevents cascading thread exhaustion and queue stagnation when the AI engine is under heavy load or degraded, cleanly falling back to in-process Winnowing.
